mapper.insert: INSERT INTO health_info( member_id, record_date, weight, fat, muscle ) VALUES ( #{memberId}, #{recordDate}, #{weight}, #{fat}, #{muscle})
mapper.update: UPDATE health_info SET record_date = #{recordDate}, weight = #{weight}, fat = #{fat}, muscle = #{muscle} WHERE member_id = #{memberId} and record_date = curdate()
mapper.select: SELECT member.member_id, member.height, health_info.weight, ROUND(health_info.weight / ((member.height / 100) * (member.height / 100)), 1) AS bmi, health_info.fat, health_info.muscle, health_info.record_date FROM member JOIN health_info ON member.member_id = health_info.member_id WHERE member.member_id = #{memberId} AND health_info.weight > 0 AND health_info.weight IS NOT NULL ORDER BY health_info.record_date DESC, health_record_id DESC LIMIT 1;
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO member ( member_id, height, goal_weight, diet_period, grade_id, base_activity_level, daily_intake_kcal, daily_burn_kcal ) VALUES ( #{memberId}, #{height}, #{goalWeight}, #{dietPeriod}, 1, #{baseActivityLevel}, #{dailyIntakeKcal}, #{dailyBurnKcal})
mapper.update: UPDATE member SET height = #{height}, goal_weight = #{goalWeight}, diet_period =#{dietPeriod}, base_activity_level = #{baseActivityLevel}, daily_intake_kcal = #{dailyIntakeKcal}, daily_burn_kcal = #{dailyBurnKcal} WHERE member_id = #{memberId}
mapper.select: select member.height, member.goal_weight, member.diet_period, member.base_activity_level, member.daily_intake_kcal, member.daily_burn_kcal, health_info.weight from member left join health_info on member.member_id = health_info.member_id where member.member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY health_info.record_date DESC LIMIT 1

select member.height, member.weight, member.goal_weight, member.diet_period, member.base_activity_level, user.birth_date, user.gender FROM member inner join user on member.member_id = user.member_id WHERE member.member_id = #{memberId}
SELECT * FROM ( SELECT record_date, weight FROM health_info WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND weight > 0 ORDER BY record_date DESC LIMIT 7 ) AS recent_data ORDER BY record_date ASC
mapper.insert: insert into health_info( member_id, sleep_hour, water_intake, bowel_count, record_date ) value ( #{memberId}, #{sleepHour}, #{waterIntake}, #{bowelCount}, curdate() )
mapper.update: update health_info set sleep_hour = #{sleepHour}, water_intake = #{waterIntake}, bowel_count = #{bowelCount} where member_id = #{memberId} and date(record_date) = curdate()
mapper.select: SELECT sleep_hour AS sleepHour, water_intake AS waterIntake, bowel_count AS bowelCount FROM health_info WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND DATE(record_date) = CURDATE() LIMIT 1
select height from member where member_id = #{memberId}
select goal_weight from member where member_id = #{memberId}
select diet_period from member where member_id = #{memberId}
select record_date, weight from health_info where member_id = #{memberId} and weight > 0 order by record_date desc
select EXISTS( select 1 from health_info where member_id = #{memberId} and record_date = curdate() )

SELECT record_date AS recordDate, sleep_hour AS sleepHour, water_intake AS waterIntake, bowel_count AS bowelCount FROM health_info WHERE health_record_id IN ( SELECT MAX(health_record_id) FROM health_info WHERE member_id = #{memberId} GROUP BY record_date ) AND ( (sleep_hour IS NOT NULL AND sleep_hour > 0) OR (water_intake IS NOT NULL AND water_intake > 0) OR (bowel_count IS NOT NULL AND bowel_count > 0) ) ORDER BY record_date DESC;
